title: Data import
lead: Move clients, services, domains, invoices, tickets and more from WHMCS. Every import starts with a dry run that writes nothing.
empty_text: Connect to a WHMCS database or its API to preview what would be imported.

lead.dry_run: What the import would do. Nothing has been written yet.

new.title: Connect to WHMCS
new.lead: Credentials are encrypted for this import only and wiped when it finishes (at the latest after 24 hours).
new.db_lead: Read-only access to the WHMCS MySQL / MariaDB database brings the most data, including password hashes and encrypted fields.
new.secret_hint: Stored encrypted for this import only; never shown again.
new.cc_hash_hint: From WHMCS configuration.php. Needed to decrypt hosting account and server passwords; card data is never read.
new.attach_lead: WHMCS keeps attachments on disk, not in the database. Give API credentials to fetch them; otherwise they are listed as skipped.
new.access_key_hint: Only if your WHMCS restricts API access by IP and uses an access key.
new.api_lead: Use when the database is not reachable. Create an API credential with a role that allows the read actions.
new.api_limits: The API cannot return password hashes, tax rules, client groups, notes, configurable options, product add-ons or the knowledge base, and gives less detail on servers, services and domains. These are listed as skipped in the report.
new.connected: Connected. Choose what to import and run the preview.

run.title: Import from {source}
run.not_draft: This import can no longer be changed.
run.secrets_gone: The source credentials were wiped. Start a new import to connect again.
run.cancel_requested: Cancellation requested; the import stops after the current batch.
run.cancel_confirm: Stop this import after the current batch?
run.start_lead: Existing records with the same e-mail, domain or number are matched and left unchanged. The import can be rolled back as long as nothing new refers to the imported records.
run.cutover_warning: Open invoices are imported without sending e-mails. Reminders, late fees and suspensions stay off for imported records during the grace days, and billing automation stays paused until you resume it.
run.confirm_cutover: I have stopped WHMCS automation (cron) and want to import now.
run.live_activity: The shop has been live since the last import: {count} invoices, payments, orders or credit entries were created here after {since}.
run.confirm_live_required: Tick the confirmation for a re-import into a live shop.
run.confirm_live: I know the shop is live: re-import anyway. Records changed here since then may be overwritten by WHMCS data; credit used here is never added back.

map.title: Mapping
map.lead: Choose what WHMCS gateways, registrars, servers, products and admin roles become here.
map.invalid: A mapping points to something that does not belong to this account.
map.role_needs_staff_manage: Mapping admin roles needs the staff management permission. Leave the role mappings empty or ask someone who manages staff.
map.role_owner: Imported staff never get the owner role. Grant it in Staff after the import.
map.role_escalation: You can only map roles whose permissions you hold yourself.
map.staff_inactive: Imported staff members start deactivated and without a password: someone who manages staff activates them in Staff, then they set a password with "forgot password".

options.entities_lead: Records that depend on an unselected item are skipped and listed in the report.
options.title: Options
options.lead: Silent mode: imported clients receive no e-mails.
options.pause_automation: Pause billing automation until I resume it
options.verified_emails: Treat imported e-mail addresses as verified
options.grace_days_hint: Imported services are not suspended and no reminders are sent during this period.
options.content_locale: Language of knowledge base and announcements

report.title: Report
report.lead: Skipped records, conflicts and errors, one line each.

rollback.title: Roll back
rollback.lead: Deletes every record this import created. Matched existing records are not touched.
rollback.confirm: I understand that the imported records will be deleted.
rollback.not_possible: Only a finished import can be rolled back.

cutover.title: Cut-over checklist
cutover.lead: Check these before switching billing automation back on.
cutover.paused_notice: Billing automation (invoices, reminders, suspensions) is paused because of an import.
cutover.overdue: {count} imported services would be suspended now without the grace period.
cutover.terminate: {count} imported suspended services would be queued for termination.
cutover.resume_confirm: Resume invoicing, reminders and suspensions now?

connection.title: Connection
connection.forget_confirm: Wipe the stored source credentials? You will need to connect again.

unsupported.title: Not imported
unsupported.lead: WHMCS data with no place in HostingOS, or not available through this connection.

login.reset_required: Your account was moved from our previous system. For your security, please set a new password: we have e-mailed you a link.
